page.overview:
Who is Creator?

The Creator is the main antagonist in The Final Fantasy Legend. He had originally created humanity, the Tower, Ashura, and is the mastermind behind the events that have plagued humanity from the very beginning.

The Creator appears as a long-haired androgynous human wearing a tuxedo with a black top hat when interacting with the party throughout their adventure.

When fighting the party, he appears with blue and white robes and has a three-pronged hat (this is not made apparent in the Game Boy game due to the monochromatic graphics, but it's shown in the Wonderswan Color version). He also possesses long blonde hair, blank yellow eyes, and chartruse skin.

The Creator is the mastermind behind the story's events. His motives for doing so varied depending on the version of the game. In the English version, he created the Tower to test the courage of humanity to see if humans had the valor to defeat evil. When the party reject the reward offered by him he insists that because he created everything he is allowed to use his creation as he sees fit. This was also briefly foreshadowed in the Tower's 20th floor which made clear that someone was controlling Ashura's actions.
